newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury Finance rating suspended.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury Finance rating suspended.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co said Thursday it has suspended its rating on Mercury Finance Co a day after the consumer finance company reported accounting regularities and restated its earnings for the past four years.
--"We are extremely concerned about the implications of these occurences and the related restatement of earnings," Gruntal said in a research report.
--The stock did not open Wednesday and was still halted late Thursday morning, but Gruntal recommended holders exit positions "as soon as possible."

--While the company said that it believes its financial condition remains strong and will support continuing operations, Gruntal said it remains concerned until the company's audit is finished in March.
--Also, the acquisition of BankBoston Corp's Fidelity Acceptance unit, which Gruntal said was largely responsible for the recent rise in the stock price, is in question, Gruntal noted.
